## User-facing outcome
Describe an operational feature in the existing Chatbliz/Zuxuru codebase.

## Package and trial impact
Specify trial eligibility, 30-day expiration, profile and Studio limits, Enterprise contracts.

## Scope
- [ ] Use existing architecture, no parallel app
- [ ] Tenant authorization on every read/write
- [ ] Voice-first accessibility where applicable
- [ ] Real task execution with approvals
- [ ] Logging, errors and no fake success
- [ ] Unit/integration tests and build verification
- [ ] Security, privacy and consent review

## Acceptance criteria
State verifiable inputs, outputs, edge cases and rollback.
